eod.conclusion: Indian benchmarks closed lower after failing to sustain early gains. The Nifty and Bank Nifty underperformed the Sensex, with financial stocks dragging the indices down. While some reports highlighted a three-day winning streak earlier in the session, the market ultimately gave up its advances. Volatility remained a key theme as indices swung between gains and losses before settling in negative territory.
